trailhead.label: The Rio Gere car park, the board’s start

cautions: A steep, eroded climb of over 300 m on path 204 to Forcella Zumeles, with loose scree just below the saddle: sure footing needed, for you and your dog.
About 200 m beside the SR48 at Rio Gere at the start: keep your dog on a short lead.
The walk ends on the SS51 at Ospitale: keep your dog close by the road.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.

textIt.The Rio Gere car park, the board’s start: Il parcheggio di Rio Gere, la partenza ufficiale
textIt.A steep, eroded climb of over 300 m on p: Una salita ripida ed erosa di oltre 300 m sul sentiero 204 verso Forcella Zumeles, con ghiaione sotto la forcella: serve passo sicuro, per te e per il cane.
textIt.About 200 m beside the SR48 at Rio Gere: Circa 200 m accanto alla SR48 a Rio Gere alla partenza: tieni il cane al guinzaglio corto.
textIt.The walk ends on the SS51 at Ospitale: k: La passeggiata finisce sulla SS51 a Ospitale: tieni il cane vicino a te lungo la strada.
